# tfcensus

tfcensus lists Terraform/OpenTofu and Terragrunt units and their state, finds AWS
resources that no unit manages, and audits state backends. It is read-only by default.

stdout carries data, stderr carries logs. Use --format json for scripting.

Docs: https://tfcensus.sasskovacs.dev.

## Usage

```sh
tfcensus <command>
```

The [global flags](/cli/global-flags) work with every command.

## Examples

```sh
tfcensus doctor --profile 'acme-*'
tfcensus units
tfcensus scan --profile 'acme-*' --fail-on unmanaged
tfcensus audit backend --format md
```
